fixes.explanation: Gideon, Israel's leader in the fight with Midian, hears the offer: rule over us, you, your son and your grandson. He says, “I will not rule over you, nor will my son. The LORD shall rule over you.” (Judges 8:23) That's the answer, baker. I can't even say no to a second cookie, and this man turned down being the one in charge.

Gideon placed the ephod in Ophrah, his hometown. Hold on to that spot, friend, because the very next words tell us what happened there. The verse says all Israel worshiped it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his household. (Judges 8:27)
Shiloh is a good guess, friend, but that's not the town the text names. It says Gideon placed the ephod in Ophrah, his hometown. (Judges 8:27) Shiloh doesn't come up in this passage at all.
Bethel is a fair guess, but it's not the town the text names. It says Gideon placed the ephod in Ophrah, his hometown. (Judges 8:27) Bethel doesn't come up anywhere in this passage.
